appName.description: Browser tab title, installed-app name and in-app brand text. null or omitted: 'Powerhouse Connect'.

icon.description: App icon master (1024x1024 PNG recommended, or an SVG). The favicons and installed-app icons are found next to it as <name>_16x16.png, _32x32, _64x64, _192x192 and _512x512; the 64 px one is the in-app logo. null or omitted: Connect's icon.

anyOf.description: Image reference: a project-relative file path, a URL, or a data URI.

favicon.description: The browser tab icon: a file (.ico, .svg or .png) relative to the project, served and built as icon.ico, or as icon.svg or icon.png for those types. A build input; the built runtime config leaves it out. `ph connect build --favicon` wins over it.

loader.description: The loading image (first paint, app start, drive and editor loading). A path gets a gentle pulse; { src, animation, size } says otherwise, with animation "none" for an image that animates itself (animated SVG, GIF or WebP). null or omitted: Connect's animated logo.

anyOf.description: Image reference: a project-relative file path, a URL, or a data URI.

src.description: Image reference: a project-relative file path, a URL, or a data URI.

animation.description: Motion applied to the image (default pulse).

size.description: Rendered width in CSS pixels (default 96); the height follows the image.

branding.description: App identity and visual branding. Every field is optional; null means the default.

background.description: The home screen's background: { color, layers } with each image positioned and sized, or one image pinned bottom-right. null or omitted: the bundled gradient.

anyOf.description: Image reference: a project-relative file path, a URL, or a data URI.

color.description: The page colour, or { light, dark }. Omitted or null: the theme's page background.

light.description: Image reference: a project-relative file path, a URL, or a data URI.

anyOf.description: Image reference: a project-relative file path, a URL, or a data URI.

src.description: One image for both colour schemes, or { light, dark } (dark falls back to light).

position.description: Distances to the pane's edges; at most one per axis. Omitted: centred both ways.

top.description: A CSS length: a number is px; a string is used as written ("40%", "min(55%, 880px)", "calc(50% - 120px)").

right.description: A CSS length: a number is px; a string is used as written ("40%", "min(55%, 880px)", "calc(50% - 120px)").

bottom.description: A CSS length: a number is px; a string is used as written ("40%", "min(55%, 880px)", "calc(50% - 120px)").

width.description: A CSS length: a number is px; a string is used as written ("40%", "min(55%, 880px)", "calc(50% - 120px)").

height.description: A CSS length: a number is px; a string is used as written ("40%", "min(55%, 880px)", "calc(50% - 120px)").

minWidth.description: A CSS length: a number is px; a string is used as written ("40%", "min(55%, 880px)", "calc(50% - 120px)").

minHeight.description: A CSS length: a number is px; a string is used as written ("40%", "min(55%, 880px)", "calc(50% - 120px)").

maxWidth.description: A CSS length: a number is px; a string is used as written ("40%", "min(55%, 880px)", "calc(50% - 120px)").

maxHeight.description: A CSS length: a number is px; a string is used as written ("40%", "min(55%, 880px)", "calc(50% - 120px)").

fade.description: Feather depth per edge, fading the layer into the page colour.

top.description: A CSS length: a number is px; a string is used as written ("40%", "min(55%, 880px)", "calc(50% - 120px)").

right.description: A CSS length: a number is px; a string is used as written ("40%", "min(55%, 880px)", "calc(50% - 120px)").

items.description: An image laid over the page, absolutely positioned: the edges set in `position` pin it, an axis with neither edge set is centred.

layers.description: Painted in order; the first is at the back.

anyOf.description: Layered images over a page colour, or a single image pinned to the bottom-right corner. null keeps the default.

home.description: The home screen (the generic chrome's landing page).

logLevel.description: Log level applied by Connect's logger at boot. Affects browser-side output only.

basePath.description: Base path Connect is mounted under (e.g. '/connect' for subpath deploys). Normalised at runtime to start and end with '/'. Defaults to the build-time BASE_URL.

offline.description: When true (default), the build emits a precaching service worker so Connect's app shell works offline, and the SPA registers it at boot. Set false to opt this deployment out: no service worker is built, the SPA skips registration, and any previously-installed worker is unregistered.

studioMode.description: Studio mode. Enables builder-only capabilities: Connect loads the vetra package and exposes DocumentModel (and vetra spec types) as creatable documents. Forced on by `ph vetra` / `ph connect studio`; false by default.

cookieBanner.description: Show the analytics cookie consent banner on a first visit, when a plugin that needs consent (Sentry, OpenPanel) is active. When false, no banner is shown and analytics consent stays rejected. `ph vetra` turns it off for its local Studio; true by default.

workflowsEnabled.description: Powerhouse workflows in Connect. When true the tab loads the @powerhousedao/workflow package (workflow + connection documents, their editors and Workflow Studio) and the reactor worker registers its document models. Falls back to the top-level `workflows.enabled`; set it to override that for Connect. Independent of studioMode. False when neither is set.

assistantEnabled.description: When true, Connect mounts the in-browser AI assistant (bottom-right chat FAB that talks to a user-configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint and acts on the reactor). Disabled by default.

externalEnabled.description: When false, Connect refuses to load any package that wasn't bundled at build time. Affirmative replacement for the legacy PH_CONNECT_EXTERNAL_PACKAGES_DISABLED env var.

liveReload.description: When true, Connect subscribes to the static-mode `/__packages` SSE channel so live publishes flow into the running tab without a page reload. Only works under hosting that serves this channel (e.g. ph-clint static mode).

packages.description: Runtime behaviour for the Connect package manager (separate from top-level `packages[]`, which lists which packages to load).

allowAddDrive.description: When false, the SPA hides the 'add drive' affordance entirely (top-level). Per-section overrides live in `sections.{remote,local}.allowAdd`.

defaultDrives.description: Drives the SPA auto-connects to on first load. Each entry is either a remote drive (a URL, with optional name/icon overrides) or a local drive (created locally on first boot, with a stable id and optional name/icon/app).

local.description: Discriminator: this entry is a local drive created on first boot.

id.description: Stable drive id. The drive is created with this id on first boot and is not re-created on later boots.

app.description: Drive app (preferred editor) to open on the drive.

preserveStrategy.description: Strategy applied when defaultDrives change between deploys. 'preserve-all' keeps user-added drives untouched; 'preserve-by-url-and-detach' detaches removed default drives. No schema default — opt-in only.

enabled.description: When false, the section is hidden in the sidebar.

allowAdd.description: When false, the section's 'add drive' affordance is hidden.

allowDelete.description: When false, drives in this section cannot be deleted from the UI.

remote.description: Visibility and add/delete affordances for a drive section in the sidebar.

enabled.description: When false, the section is hidden in the sidebar.

allowAdd.description: When false, the section's 'add drive' affordance is hidden.

allowDelete.description: When false, drives in this section cannot be deleted from the UI.

local.description: Visibility and add/delete affordances for a drive section in the sidebar.

sections.description: Per-section visibility and affordance toggles. `remote` covers what was historically split into 'public' + 'cloud'; `local` is browser-local drives.

icons.description: The drive explorer's icons (the generic plugin's); each null keeps the built-in icon.

localDrive.description: Local drives without an icon of their own.

anyOf.description: Image reference: a project-relative file path, a URL, or a data URI.

remoteDrive.description: Remote drives without an icon of their own.

anyOf.description: Image reference: a project-relative file path, a URL, or a data URI.
Image reference: a project-relative file path, a URL, or a data URI.

document.description: Documents whose type has no icon in `documents`.

anyOf.description: Image reference: a project-relative file path, a URL, or a data URI.

additionalProperties.description: Image reference: a project-relative file path, a URL, or a data URI.

anyOf.description: The drive explorer's icons (the generic plugin's); each null keeps the built-in icon.

chainId.description: CAIP-2 chain reference within the network namespace.

namespace.description: Renown localStorage namespace; share it across Connects to share login.

switchboardUrl.description: Switchboard GraphQL URL. When set, Connect enables in-page (no-redirect) Renown sign-in; otherwise it falls back to the redirect flow via `url`.

walletConnectProjectId.description: WalletConnect project id; required for this adapter to function.

infuraProjectId.description: Optional Infura project id used to build RPC transports.

appId.description: Privy application id; required for this adapter to function.

methods.description: Login methods this adapter offers; default per adapter when omitted.

adapters.description: Per-adapter wallet config for in-page auth. Presence of an adapter key enables it; omit or leave empty for redirect-only behaviour.

dsn.description: Sentry DSN URL. `null` disables Sentry entirely; the SPA never loads the Sentry SDK chunk.

env.description: Sentry environment label, surfaced as the `environment` tag on every event.

sentry.description: Sentry error-tracking coordinates. Set `dsn` to enable Sentry; leave `dsn` null to disable. The Sentry release tag stays build-time (stamped via Vite's `define` from WORKSPACE_VERSION) so it always matches the sourcemaps uploaded by CI.

clientId.description: OpenPanel client id. Empty string disables OpenPanel entirely.

apiUrl.description: OpenPanel API URL for self-hosted instances (e.g. 'https://openpanel.example/api'). Omit to use OpenPanel's hosted API.

openPanel.description: OpenPanel product analytics. Set `clientId` to enable; an empty `clientId` disables it. Events are only sent after the user accepts analytics cookies. Takes precedence over the build-time PH_CONNECT_OPENPANEL_* env vars.

namespace.description: Explicit storage/SharedWorker namespace for this instance. `null` derives it from the base path (and, later, the configured endpoint), so root deployments stay byte-identical.

reactorWorker.description: Host the reactor in a shared worker instead of on the main thread. Off by default; the main-thread reactor stays the proven path until cutover is verified. Packaged deployments load the worker from the prebuilt bundle `ph connect build` emits under __reactor_worker__/ (the dev server builds it lazily at the same path); when that bundle is absent the feature reports itself unavailable instead of starting a worker that cannot load.

multiReactor.description: Opt-in multi-reactor routing. When on, Connect routes through the in-browser reactor plus remote backends instead of the single in-browser reactor. Off by default; the single-reactor path is unchanged.

instance.description: Per-instance identity. Lets one origin host multiple isolated Connect instances, each with its own storage + SharedWorker namespace.

documentDecisions.description: Decide writes from the document stream rather than the document meta cache, so a backdated deletion denies the operations that sort after it.

authEnforcement.description: Enforce the auth scope's policy at admission, replay, and read. Requires documentDecisions.

authGroups.description: Let `{ group }` principals match against the rosters of the group documents a policy names. Requires authEnforcement.

authConditions.description: Evaluate `where` and `match` conditions on grants. Requires authGroups. Do not enable on a fleet `preflight:auth` reports as crossing a reducer version.

undoV3.description: Support base-reducer 3 (id-targeted undo), which new documents then take. A peer without it is held from base-reducer 3 documents until it upgrades. Unset leaves the reactor's default.

featureFlags.description: Reactor feature flags. The four enforcement flags each imply their predecessors, and the reactor refuses to boot on a set that names a later one without an earlier one. They are consensus settings: a Connect syncing with a fleet must carry the same enforcement flags the fleet does, or the two reach different replay outcomes for the same history and diverge. undoV3 has no prerequisites; peers negotiate it.

createSignaturePolicy.description: What new documents are created as. `v2-required` documents accept only v2 action signatures and take content-addressed ids; set `legacy` while any peer Connect syncs with predates them. Existing documents keep their policy.

unsupportedStoredDocuments.description: What the reactor does when this browser's store holds documents at protocol versions this build does not run. `refuse` fails the boot and names the versions; `read-only` boots and keeps those documents read-only.

reactor.description: Settings for the reactor Connect runs in the browser, on the main thread or in the shared worker alike.

icons.description: Icons appended to the built-in set and de-duplicated by (src, sizes, purpose).

file_handlers.description: File associations appended after Connect's built-in .phd/.phdm handler and de-duplicated on the whole entry. Entries only declare accepted types; there is no action field, because opening the files requires Connect's own runtime handling, so every handler opens at the app root.

accept.description: MIME type → file extensions. Each extension must start with '.'; browsers ignore entries without it.

launch_handler.description: How the OS launches the app for handled files/links. Connect defaults to focus-existing.

globPatterns.description: Extra Workbox precache globs, unioned with the built-ins.

globIgnores.description: Extra precache ignore globs, unioned with the built-ins.

maximumFileSizeToCacheInBytes.description: Raise the precache file-size ceiling. The max across all contributors wins, so no contributor can shrink another's limit.

runtimeCaching.description: Runtime-caching rules appended after the built-in rules. Workbox is first-match-wins, so these cannot override a built-in rule matching the same URL.

urlPattern.description: URL match. A string is matched verbatim by Workbox; { source, flags } is rebuilt into a RegExp at build time.

networkTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds a NetworkFirst rule waits for the network before falling back to the cache.

navigateFallbackDenylist.description: Extra SPA navigate-fallback denylist patterns, unioned with the built-ins.

items.description: URL match. A string is matched verbatim by Workbox; { source, flags } is rebuilt into a RegExp at build time.

pwa.description: Progressive-web-app / service-worker overrides, layered on Connect's built-in PWA defaults at build time. Scalar fields deep-merge (this layer wins); the array members (icons, file_handlers, globs, runtimeCaching and denylist patterns) are additive; maximumFileSizeToCacheInBytes takes the max across contributors. (categories is not set here — it is derived from the manifest's category field.) Only applied when connect.app.offline is true.

config.description: Connect-specific UI customisations. All fields optional; omit the section entirely for default behaviour.
